mapper.select: SELECT O.ORDER_ID, O.ORDER_TYPE, O.ORDER_STATUS, O.CREATED_AT, O.USER_ID, O.DISCOUNT_AMT, (SELECT SUM(UNIT_PRICE * QUANTITY) FROM ORDER_ITEM WHERE ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID) AS totalPrice, MIN(P.PRODUCT_NAME) AS productName, COUNT(OI.ITEM_ID) AS itemCount FROM ORDERS O LEFT JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON O.ORDER_ID = OI.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE O.USER_ID = #{userId} GROUP BY O.ORDER_ID, O.ORDER_TYPE, O.ORDER_STATUS, O.CREATED_AT, O.USER_ID, O.DISCOUNT_AMT ORDER BY O.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT O.ORDER_ID, O.ORDER_TYPE, O.ORDER_STATUS, O.TOTAL_PRICE, O.DISCOUNT_AMT, O.CREATED_AT, O.USER_ID,
U.USER_NAME AS RECEIVER_NAME, U.USER_PHONE AS RECEIVER_PHONE, A.ZIPCODE, A.ADDRESS AS DELIVERY_ADDR, A.DETAILED_ADDRESS AS DELIVERY_DETAIL_ADDR,
-- [수정] PM(payment)에서 PAID_AT, PH(payment_history)에서 PAY_TYPE 추출 PH.PAY_TYPE AS PAY_METHOD, PM.PAID_AT AS PAY_DATE,
P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME, OI.UNIT_PRICE AS ITEM_PRICE, OI.QUANTITY AS ITEM_COUNT, O.ORDER_TYPE AS ITEM_TYPE, OI.START_DATE, OI.END_DATE FROM ORDERS O INNER JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON O.ORDER_ID = OI.ORDER_ID INNER JOIN PRODUCT P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID INNER JOIN USER U ON O.USER_ID = U.USER_ID LEFT JOIN USER_ADDRESS A ON O.USER_ID = A.USER_ID AND A.DEFAULT_YN = 'Y'
-- 결제 마스터 테이블 조인 (PAID_AT 목적) LEFT JOIN payment PM ON O.ORDER_ID = PM.ORDER_ID
-- 결제 히스토리 테이블 조인 (PAY_TYPE 목적) -- 결제 완료(PAID) 상태의 가장 최근 기록 매칭 LEFT JOIN payment_history PH ON PM.PAY_ID = PH.TARGET_PAY_ID AND PH.NEW_STATUS = 'PAID'
WHERE O.ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
AND O.USER_ID = #{userId}
-- 중복 데이터 방지를 위해 하나만 선택 LIMIT 1
